error-body: The stored ranking could not be retrieved. Your inputs and any previous ranking are unaffected.
page-description: Climate mitigation actions ranked for your city based on this inventory's emissions, your socioeconomic context, regulations and strategic priorities.
empty-title: No ranking has been generated yet
empty-body: Your recommended actions will appear here once you complete the wizard and run the prioritization. Head back to the pre-flight check to review your inputs and generate the ranking.
table-description: All {{count}} actions ranked for your city. Click an action to see its full score breakdown.
impact-score-description: How much of your city's emissions this action can reduce, and how quickly it can be implemented.
alignment-score-description: How well this action is backed by policy frameworks and your strategic preferences.
feasibility-score-description: Legal verdict, socioeconomic fit and financial feasibility for your city.
no-description: No description is available for this action yet.
generate-report-hint: Select one or more actions to build a report.
generate-report-duration_one: About half a minute — the report is written for the action you selected.
generate-report-duration_other: About half a minute per action — {{count}} reports will be written.
report-error-title: Some reports could not be generated
report-error-none: No reports could be generated. This is usually temporary — try again in a moment.
report-error-snapshot-title: This ranking cannot produce reports yet
report-error-snapshot: Reports are written from a saved copy of the ranking run, and this inventory does not have one — it was ranked before reports existed. Re-run the ranking to create it; your preferences and exclusions are unchanged.
report-error-fetch: Your saved reports could not be loaded, so nothing new was generated. Reload the page and sign in again if the problem persists.
top-picks-description: The highest-ranked actions for this inventory and your stated priorities. Select the ones you want in a report.
timeline-info: How long this action typically takes to implement, from decision to delivery.
legal-filter-info: Every candidate action is checked against national and local law. Actions that fail a mandatory requirement are removed before scoring.
cobenefits-description: What these top picks deliver beyond emissions reduction.
tradeoffs-description: Where a top action could set another goal back.
context-description: What the model weighed to produce this ranking. Open any card for the full detail.
context-desc-emissions: The inventory this ranking scored every action against.
context-desc-socioeconomic: City indicators used to judge how well each action fits your population.
context-desc-legal: Candidate actions checked against national and local law before scoring.
context-desc-financial: How much of each action your city can realistically finance and deliver.
context-desc-policy: How well ranked actions are backed by existing policy frameworks.
context-summary-computed: Computed by the model — open for the detail.
stat-average-alignment-sub: Mean alignment score across every ranked action.
full-ranking-description: Every action scored for your city, in rank order.
context-summary-not-retrieved: Not retrieved yet — pull this inventory's emissions from CityCatalyst.
column-composition-info: How the final score is made up: impact, alignment and feasibility, each multiplied by its weight.
glance-description: Final score of the {{count}} ranked actions, coloured by sector. Click a bar to open the action.
glance-keyboard-note: Use the table below to browse with a keyboard.
context-summary-no-emissions: This inventory has no emissions yet — add data in the GHGI module first.
context-summary-no-indicators: No socioeconomic indicators on record for this city.
context-summary-indicators: Income, employment, housing and mobility shape how feasible each action is here.
funnel-aria: {{assessed}} actions assessed, {{passed}} passed legal review, {{ranked}} ranked
composition-tip-note: Each pillar's score (0–1) is multiplied by its weight; the three parts add up to the final score.
sector-share-tip-note: The model weights an action's impact by how much of your inventory its sector represents.
funnel-tip-note: Actions your municipality lacks the legal authority to implement are removed before scoring; only the top-ranked ones are listed.
stat-national-alignment-note: Average policy support across national climate plans, for all assessed actions. Higher means more actions are already backed by national policy.
context-summary-legal-removed: {{excluded}} actions were removed before scoring because the city cannot implement them on its own authority.
route-tip-note: How each candidate action would most realistically be funded, given the city's budget autonomy and delivery capacity.
insight-sector-focus: {{count}} of {{total}} ranked actions target {{sector}}, your largest emitting sector ({{share}}% of emissions).
insight-sector-mismatch: Most ranked actions target {{sector}} ({{count}} of {{total}}). {{topSector}}, your largest source at {{share}}% of emissions, has {{topCount}}.
insight-driver: {{pillar}} drives the ranking: on average it accounts for {{pct}}% of each final score.
insight-legal: Legal screening removed {{excluded}} of {{assessed}} catalog actions; {{passed}} were eligible for scoring.
insight-policy: {{strong}} of {{total}} ranked actions are strongly backed by existing policy; national plan alignment averages {{pct}}%.
insight-policy-no-plan: {{strong}} of {{total}} ranked actions are strongly backed by existing policy.
insight-finance: {{count}} of {{total}} ranked actions can be funded from the city's own budget.
insight-timeline: {{count}} of {{total}} ranked actions can be implemented in under five years.
